*'Katana Robo: RTA' is a game developed with a focus on speedrunning. This game provides a competitive environment for players by clearly defining the start and end points of a speedrun through an official timer. Integrated within the game itself, this timer allows for accurate time measurement, enabling players to objectively compare and compete with their records.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2658810/Katana_Robo_RTA/

notes.title: (Katana Robo: RTA) 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Update Notice[/h2]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.speedrun.com/Katana_Robo_RTA]'Katana Robo: RTA'[/url]s SPEEDRUN.COM (Leaderboards) has been newly added.
[*]To focus more on SPEEDRUN (Leaderboards), the World Battle hashtag display in the upper right corner has been removed.
[*]We have improved some of the terrain that impedes movement and adjusted it to allow for smooth movement.
[/list]
[b]▼[url=https://www.speedrun.com/Katana_Robo_RTA]'Katana Robo: RTA'[/url]s SPEEDRUN.COM (Leaderboards) has been newly added.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770824/60ce626aae8e1ad7898cc3619449024e62dff76e.png[/img]
[b]▼To focus more on SPEEDRUN (Leaderboards), the World Battle hashtag display in the upper right corner has been removed.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770824/cc0579bcaa6176db19b2e7318a4b9cdfbd5ece65.png[/img]
[b]▼We have improved some of the terrain that impedes movement and adjusted it to allow for smooth movement.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770824/f9ec0cf126181532fd206f10de4b2e5c22ca824a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770824/453a91f3c1a58e96257d5f44a7fd48c7e9174916.png[/img]

* We believe that competition through SPEEDRUN is more effective than the World Battle hashtag, so from December 19, 2023 (PST), 'Katana Robo: RTA' will focus on 'SPEEDRUN (Leaderboards)'.

*The ‘World Battle Hashtag #KatanaRoboRTA’ information in the store will be changed to the ‘SPEEDRUN (Leaderboards)’ information.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2658810/Katana_Robo_RTA/

notes.title: 2023-12-15(PST) Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]We have corrected the phenomenon of 'Rolling Boy' disappearing at a certain probability and level issues that interfere with game progress.
[*]Fixed an issue where 'Grappling Hooks' could not be used when performing certain actions during gameplay.
[/list]
